About me

Hi! My name is Sofia, I'm an illustrator and graphic designer. I especially love projects related to layout and book design, and I also create visual identities for brands — such as advertising creatives, postcards, brochures, or posters.

If you're looking for someone who can truly understand and feel your project's idea in order to visualise it exactly as you envision it — I'll be happy to help you. Here you can explore my specialised portfolio and CV, visit my shop with paintings, or book drawing lessons for your child.

Don't hesitate to write to me if you have any questions or ideas — Sofiiacart@gmail.com
